title: What If Every Fly on Earth Vanished?

scenes.text: What if every fly on Earth vanished tomorrow? Start with your chocolate.
Flies are a giant group, over one hundred twenty-five thousand known species, and possibly more than a million.
Cacao flowers last only a day or two, and tiny midges, which are flies, are among their most important pollinators.
Hoverflies visit about half of the world's major food crop plants, crops worth roughly three hundred billion dollars a year.
Fly larvae also clean up. Fifty housefly larvae turned four hundred forty-four kilograms of pig slurry into compost.
Bees would still be buzzing. But a lot of the world's pollinators and cleanup crew would be gone.

description:
What if every fly on Earth vanished?
Flies pollinate cacao and half of the major food crop plants, and their larvae break down waste.
Which fly would you miss first?
